name: singularitysbounty
title: singularity's bounty
blurb: catblanketflower.yuwakisa.com asked buildthis to read all their skeets and write a PMP to establish their brand, then asked for a from-scratch rebuild after the first pass shipped with someone else's page in it. Sourced from all 30,419 records on their PDS: the Suno music habit, the yuwakisa.com toy factory, the language-and-LLMs philosophizing, and the case for hitting subscribe.
